Output 0 follows its target's ordering reasonably well because that target happens to align with the intensity. Targets 1, 2 and do not follow that alternating pattern.

pathway_activity.decoder_text: Nineteen of the twenty-four first-layer units respond on every sample and the other five (units 3, 8, 14, 19 and 22) never leave zero. The responding units do not act independently: each one is the same per-sample intensity multiplied by a fixed unit-specific gain, so the whole layer carries a single channel of information. The second layer repeats this with nine of its twelve units responding and three dormant, again as fixed multiples of the same intensity.

representational_structure.decoder_text: Layer-one activations lie exactly on a single ray from the origin. The batch is ordered along that ray by intensity, with the weakest sample sitting almost at the origin and the strongest farthest out; the covariance has one non-trivial direction and every other direction carries no variance. The second layer maps that ray onto another ray, so depth adds no new dimensions.
